variations.name: 컷 R
variations.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one standalone original R logo for RandyPick, a Korean Warcraft III random-defense unit recommendation companion, for randypick.com. The ACTUAL live website is a restrained almost-black/off-white interface: bold Korean grotesk headlines, small widely spaced monospace labels, fine panel borders, quiet dot-grid backdrop, a tiny mint status light and selective muted amber highlights only in recommendation UI. The logo must fit this editorial, analytical, calm gaming-tool identity. Design direction: Pure geometric uppercase R, off-white solid fill. Broad vertical stem, squared rounded bowl, one precise diagonal stencil cut separating the forward leg. Ultra concise modern grotesk letterform. No checkmark. Output only ONE finished R symbol, centered on a perfectly uniform solid almost-black #0A0A0A background, square canvas, mark about 65% of canvas height with generous margins. All negative spaces are the exact same solid #0A0A0A as the background. Extremely crisp, professionally balanced flat vector graphic. No wordmark, no labels or numbers, no mockup, no presentation sheet, no canvas border. No 3D, metallic effects, gradients, textures, lighting, shadows, glow, speckles, mascots, crowns, weapons or game characters. Only opaque solid fills, precisely smooth edges. Legible at a 28px header size.
